integrity: Proof uses exact Mellin identities, a positivity argument for an explicit Lévy density, characteristic-function uniqueness, and conditional Jensen. Finite numerical diagnostics supplement but do not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: One-time marginal distributional factorization only; no pathwise comparison, finite raw-clock expectation, or arbitrary subordinator extension. Independent assessment and comprehensive historical priority search have not been performed.
title: A symmetric logarithmic noise factor distinguishes reversed stable and inverse-stable clocks
